run_evaluate_mel: run the evaluate script with --guess_path and --gold_path to compute recall metrics
run_evaluate_per_language: run evaluate to compute per-language R@1 and R@10 recall scores from JSONL files
run_evaluate_with_debug: run the evaluate script with -d flag for debug logging output
run_evaluate_with_verbose: run the evaluate script with -v flag for verbose logging output
run_evaluate_micro_macro_avg: run evaluate to compute micro-avg and macro-avg recall across all languages
